verdict.rationale: Pylon's Support Agent can gather internal context and take action beyond content deflection. Connectors let agents retrieve information from external tools, and admins can define Custom API tools to call internal or third-party endpoints. Agents also work from account data already in Pylon, including product-data syncs, synced account fields and the Salesforce account mapping, so answers can draw on live customer data, not just articles. Missing for 10: no explicit documentation of customer-facing answers using plan, order status or account history; the dependence on admin-built connectors or Custom API tools for order-type data; no independent or hands-on corroboration.
